description_en: Queries information about one or more cloud disks that you have created in a dedicated block storage cluster
description_zh: 查询一块或多块您已经创建的专属块存储集群的云盘信息
name: DescribeDedicatedBlockStorageClusterDisks

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the dedicated block storage cluster. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 专属块存储集群所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 500.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页的最大条目数。最大值为500。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The dedicated block storage cluster ID
parameters.name: dbsc_id

Disks.description_en: The collection of cloud disk information

Disk.description_en: The collection of cloud disk information

items.description_en: The collection of cloud disk information

AttachedTime.description_en: The time when the cloud disk was last attached. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
AttachedTime.description_zh: 该云盘最后一次挂载的时间。按照[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，使用UTC+0时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ

BdfId.description_en: This parameter is in invitational preview and is not publicly available
BdfId.description_zh: 该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用

BurstingEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the burst (performance burst) feature is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.

This parameter is supported only when `DiskCategory` is set to `cloud_auto`. For more information, see [ESSD AutoPL cloud disks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html）
BurstingEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启Burst（性能突发）。可能值：

true：是。
false：否。

当`DiskCategory`取值为`cloud_auto`时才支持设置该参数。更多信息，请参见[ESSD AutoPL云盘]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html）

Category.description_en: The category of the cloud disk or local disk is cloud_essd, which indicates an ESSD
Category.description_zh: 云盘或本地盘种类为cloud_essd，表示ESSD云盘

DeleteAutoSnapshot.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic snapshots are deleted when the cloud disk is released. Valid values:

true: Automatic snapshots are deleted when the cloud disk is released.
false: Automatic snapshots are retained when the cloud disk is released.

Snapshots created by calling [CreateSnapshot]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25524.html） or by using the console are not affected by this parameter and are always retained
DeleteAutoSnapshot.description_zh:
是否同时删除自动快照。可能值：

true：删除云盘上的快照。
false：保留云盘上的快照。

通过[CreateSnapshot]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25524.html）或者在控制台创建的快照，不受这个参数的影响，会始终保留

DeleteWithInstance.description_en:
Indicates whether the cloud disk is released when the instance is released. Valid values:

true: The cloud disk is released when the instance is released.
false: The cloud disk is retained when the instance is released
DeleteWithInstance.description_zh:
是否随实例释放。可能值：

true：释放实例时，这块云盘随实例一起释放。
false：释放实例时，这块云盘保留不释放

DetachedTime.description_en: The time when the cloud disk was last detached
DetachedTime.description_zh: 该云盘最后一次卸载时间

Device.description_en:
The device name of the instance to which the cloud disk is attached, such as /dev/xvdb. Note the following items:

This parameter has a value only when the `Status` parameter is set to `In_use`. This parameter is empty in other states.

For cloud disks with the multi-attach feature enabled, this value is always empty. You can view all attachment information of the cloud disk from the returned `Attachment` list.

This parameter will be deprecated. To ensure code compatibility, do not use this parameter
Device.description_zh:
云盘挂载的实例的设备名，例如/dev/xvdb。您需要注意：

该参数仅在`Status`参数值为`In_use`时才有值，其他状态时为空。

对于开启多重挂载特性的云盘，该值始终为空。您可以通过返回的`Attachment`对象组成的列表，查看云盘所涉及的所有挂载信息。

该参数即将停止使用，为提高代码兼容性，建议您尽量不要使用该参数

DiskChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the cloud disk. Valid values:

PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
DiskChargeType.description_zh:
云盘的计费方式。可能值：

PrePaid：包年包月。
PostPaid：按量付费

EnableAutoSnapshot.description_en:
Indicates whether the automatic snapshot policy feature is enabled for the cloud disk.

This parameter is deprecated. After a cloud disk is created, the automatic snapshot policy feature is enabled by default. You only need to associate an automatic snapshot policy with the cloud disk
EnableAutoSnapshot.description_zh:
云盘是否启用自动快照策略功能。

该参数已弃用。创建后的云盘默认启用自动快照策略功能，您只需要为云盘绑定自动快照策略即可正常使用

Encrypted.description_en: Indicates whether the cloud disk is encrypted

IOPS.description_en: The maximum number of read/write (I/O) operations per second. Unit: operations/s
IOPS.description_zh: 每秒读写（I/O）操作的次数上限，单位：次/s

ImageId.description_en: The ID of the image used to create the ECS instance. This parameter has a value only for cloud disks created from an image. Otherwise, this value is empty. This value remains unchanged throughout the lifecycle of the cloud disk
ImageId.description_zh: 创建ECS实例时使用的镜像ID，只有通过镜像创建的云盘才有值，否则为空。这个值在云盘的生命周期内始终不变

InstanceId.description_en:
The instance ID of the instance to which the cloud disk is mounted. Note the following items:

This parameter has a value only when the `Status` parameter is set to `In_use`. This parameter is empty in other states.

For cloud disks with the multi-attach attribute enabled, this value is always empty. You can view all mount information of the cloud disk from the returned `Attachment` list
InstanceId.description_zh:
云盘挂载的实例ID。您需要注意：

该参数值仅在`Status`参数值为`In_use`时才有值，其他状态时为空。

对于开启多重挂载特性的云盘，该值始终为空。您可以通过返回的`Attachment`对象组成的列表，查看云盘所涉及的所有挂载信息

KMSKeyId.description_en: The KMS key ID used by the cloud disk

MountInstanceNum.description_en: The number of instances to which the shared storage is attached
MountInstanceNum.description_zh: 共享存储挂载的实例数量

MultiAttach.description_en: Indicates whether the multi-attach feature is enabled for the cloud disk
MultiAttach.description_zh: 云盘是否开启了多重挂载特性

PerformanceLevel.description_en:
The performance level of the ESSD. Valid values:

PL0: a maximum of 10,000 random read/write IOPS per cloud disk.
PL1: a maximum of 50,000 random read/write IOPS per cloud disk.
PL2: a maximum of 100,000 random read/write IOPS per cloud disk.
PL3: a maximum of 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS per cloud disk
PerformanceLevel.description_zh:
ESSD云盘的性能等级。可能值：

PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万。
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万。
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万。
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万

Portable.description_en: Indicates whether the cloud disk is removable

ProvisionedIops.description_en:
The provisioned read/write IOPS of the ESSD AutoPL cloud disk. Valid values: 0 to min{50000, 1000 × Capacity - Baseline performance}.

Baseline performance = min{1,800 + 50 × Capacity, 50,000}.

This parameter is supported only when `DiskCategory` is set to `cloud_auto`. For more information, see [ESSD AutoPL cloud disks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html）
ProvisionedIops.description_zh:
ESSD AutoPL云盘预配置的读写IOPS。可能值：0~min{50000, 1000*容量-基准性能}。

基准性能=min{1,800+50*容量, 50,000}。

当`DiskCategory`取值为`cloud_auto`时才支持设置该参数。更多信息，请参见[ESSD AutoPL云盘]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html）

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the cloud disk

Size.description_en: The cloud disk size. Unit: GiB

SourceSnapshotId.description_en:
The ID of the snapshot used to create the cloud disk.

If no snapshot was specified when the cloud disk was created, this value is empty. This value remains unchanged throughout the lifecycle of the cloud disk
SourceSnapshotId.description_zh:
创建云盘使用的快照ID。

如果创建云盘时，没有指定快照，则该参数值为空。该参数值在云盘的生命周期内始终不变

Status.description_en:
The cloud disk status. For more information, see [Cloud disk status]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25689.html）. Valid values:

In_use.
Available.
Attaching.
Detaching.
Creating.
ReIniting
Status.description_zh:
云盘状态。更多信息，请参见[云盘状态]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25689.html）。可能值：

In_use。
Available。
Attaching。
Detaching。
Creating。
ReIniting

StorageClusterId.description_en: The ID of the dedicated block storage cluster to which the cloud disk belongs. If the cloud disk belongs to a public cloud block storage cluster, this value is empty
StorageClusterId.description_zh: 云盘所属的专属块存储集群ID。如果您的云盘在公共云块存储集群中，则该返回值为空

StorageSetPartitionNumber.description_en: The maximum number of partitions in the storage set
StorageSetPartitionNumber.description_zh: 存储集中的最大分区数量

Tags.description_en: The tags of the cloud disk

items.description_en: The tags of the cloud disk

Throughput.description_en: The amount of data that can be transferred per unit of time. Unit: MB/s
Throughput.description_zh: 单位时间内可以成功传输的数据数量，单位：MB/s

Type.description_en:
The type of the cloud disk. Valid values:

system: system cloud disk.
data: data cloud disk
Type.description_zh:
要查询的云盘类型。可能值：

system：系统盘。
data：数据盘

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the cloud disk

Disk.title_en:
参考ECS DescribeDisks接口的返回结果
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25514.html
Disk.title_zh:
参考ECS DescribeDisks接口的返回结果
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25514.html

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned in this call
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值
NextToken.title_en: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值。
NextToken.title_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值。
